title: The talk is booked. Is the prep?
hook: The presentation is in your calendar. Are you ready for it?

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that preparation that must be finished before an event needs its own block before it, or the calendar shows more free time than there is

misconception: Preparation can happen in the gaps; only the meeting itself needs a calendar slot.
objective: Schedule preparation before a dependent live task.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: The presentation is in your calendar. Are you ready for it? The presentation is at 30 and needs 20 minutes' prep. With nothing booked before it, are you ready? Options: Only if prep is booked before 30 / Yes: prep fits somewhere. Correct option: Only if prep is booked before 30. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

recall.question: A 15:00 pitch needs 40 minutes of preparation, and you are free from 14:00. Which booking works?
recall.why: Preparation must finish before the event that depends on it, so it needs its own block ending by 15:00.
